title: Residue-field criterion for a map of finite locally free modules
statement: Let $S$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme] and let $v:\mathcal E\to\mathcal F$ be a morphism of finite locally free $\mathcal O_S$-modules. If for every point $s\in S$ the induced map $\mathcal E\otimes_{\mathcal O_S}\kappa(s)\to\mathcal F\otimes_{\mathcal O_S}\kappa(s)$ is an isomorphism, then $v$ is an isomorphism.
